initial_prompt: Generate a solo long-drive monologue for Kwame, driving alone on a personal trip. Include his thinking aloud about his evening course and career ambitions, a casual first mention of needing to stop that he doesn't act on, a one-sided hands-free phone call to his girlfriend about moving in together, and a quiet stretch. When the need becomes genuinely pressing later, resolve it without Sigma — a road sign for services appears just in time, or his own knowledge of this route from driving it before tells him exactly how far it is. No assistant present at any point.
